description: Use when you need a picture of one CS2 item at an exact float, pattern seed, stickers, charm, StatTrak count and name tag. Name the item with a Steam inspect link or with a catalog id from catalog_search. Returns the /api/still webp URL and an img tag. include_image: true also returns the picture; it needs INSPEKT_SECRET and counts as one render. Steam Market and inventory links (ending S...A...D... or M...A...D...) are refused; use id instead. For the live 3D viewer use embed_snippet. Example: {"id":"ak47_cu_ak47_cobra_gen","wear":0.24,"seed":661,"view":"front","bg":"rarity","width":640,"height":400}

bg.description: Background. steel is the default, rarity is the item tier plate, transparent keeps alpha.

offsetX.description: X of the hanging point in Source units, -64 to 64. Send all three offsets or none.

offsetY.description: Y of the hanging point in Source units, -64 to 64. Send all three offsets or none.

offsetZ.description: Z of the hanging point in Source units, -64 to 64. Send all three offsets or none.

stickerId.description: Sticker in a Sticker Slab. defIndex 37 only.

height.description: Pixels, 160 to 2560. Default 630. Above 1600 needs a key on a plan and counts extra renders.

include_image.description: Also return the picture as an image block. Needs INSPEKT_SECRET and counts as one render.

inspect.description: Steam inspect link with the item as hex (copied from inside CS2, or a gen link), or the hex alone.

name.description: Name tag, up to 20 printable characters. Only with id.

seed.description: Pattern seed, 0 to 1000. Only with id.

stattrak.description: Kill counter. Any value makes the item StatTrak, 0 included. Only with id.

stickers.description: Up to 5 stickers. Only with id.

offsetX.description: Move from the slot default, -1 to 1.

offsetY.description: Move from the slot default, -1 to 1.

slot.description: Sticker position, 0 to 7. A slot may repeat.

view.description: Camera. hero (default) is the inventory icon angle, front is square-on for listing rows.

width.description: Pixels, 160 to 2560. Default 1200. Above 1600 needs a key on a plan and counts extra renders.

name: render_still
title: Render a CS2 skin still
